column1: # Miri's table (decision 32.58): one row a kernel test, `state<TAB>nextest binary id<TAB>test
# name`, written by `kernel-quality miri-times` from a measuring run's nextest report, never by
# hand. A state is the seconds Miri takes to finish the test, always under the 600 s budget; or
# `native-only over N`, a measuring run stopped it after N s with no verdict; or `native-only N`,
# it finished in N s, at or over the budget. A native-only test runs natively only. Seconds are a
# CI runner's; a development machine's run is scaled to them. `geom_test::miri::plan` balances the
# partitions by the finishing rows, and Miri's plan fails on a test with no row. geom-pool's rows
